subject.title: Bug: partialArgs JSON duplication in agentTurn cron jobs with isolated sessionTarget

question: Should OpenClaw repair duplicated complete tool-call argument JSON only when every parsed object is semantically identical, replace cumulative snapshots in the stream layer after provider proof, or keep failing closed for all structured suffixes?
rationale: This choice determines whether malformed provider output can be converted into executable file or command tool arguments, which is a security-sensitive behavior boundary rather than a purely mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Repair identical duplicates only
options.body: Accept a second complete object only when it is semantically identical to the first, add conflicting-object tests, and require live provider or isolated-cron proof.

options.title: Handle cumulative snapshots in transport
options.body: Move the behavior into the OpenAI-compatible stream assembly layer, replacing rather than appending only with provider-specific proof that the chunks are snapshots.

options.title: Keep failing closed
options.body: Preserve current rejection for structured suffixes and document that affected providers need a safer transport-specific fix before tools execute.

recommendation.title: Repair identical duplicates only
recommendation.body: Accept a second complete object only when it is semantically identical to the first, add conflicting-object tests, and require live provider or isolated-cron proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal for the malformed tool-call argument repair and OpenAI-compatible provider transport area points to vincentkoc.
